label: Mint member token
description: Hand a member's browser or extension a token that acts as them in this program, and nothing else: it starts their runs (in the `Weft-Member-Token` header on a live route), answers their waits, shows their own copies' displays and lets them connect their own accounts. It always expires. The value comes out once; keep it only where the member can use it.

inputs.name: member
inputs.description: The member, by the id your program uses for them (`user-42`).

inputs.name: expiresInHours
inputs.description: How long the token works, in hours (a year at most).

outputs.name: expiresAt
outputs.description: When it stops working, in unix seconds.
